purpose: Validity-first locked external-cohort reanalysis of the frozen five-checkpoint D07-003/E55 model in MIMIC-IV v3.1 and two non-overlapping NHANES releases; zero-shot means checkpoint parameters are not updated from external data and does not mean untouched, prospective, or independent confirmatory validation.

covers_or_reserves: CLIP vocabulary extension encoding and model restore
stage05 and stage06 four-model conditional B=200 bootstrap statistics
complete shared-core PH diagnostics for all target/death model covariates
publication copy, rehash, and receipt validation
operational_reservation.monitoring: retain resumable stage receipts and monitor RAM, disk, and elapsed time

reviewer_editor_alignment.Reviewer1_Major6: external validation is interpreted through calibration, domain shift, differing disease ascertainment, and explicitly sensitivity-only recalibration; weak transport remains reportable
reviewer_editor_alignment.Reviewer2_Comment2: the exact sequence alignment and external code, text, phenotype, unit, and missingness mappings are published and mechanically verified before outcome read
reviewer_editor_alignment.Editor_original_supported_scope: report results accurately, remove overstated conclusions, explain cohort and data-source limitations, and predeclare sequence alignment, outlier handling, cross-validation, model selection, bias correction, Cox assumptions, calibration, and competing death
reviewer_editor_alignment.post_V7_scientific_review: V8 closes prior-result exposure, participant-level density confounding, complete per-covariate and GLOBAL PH diagnostics, conditional-utility language, and NHANES release-slot QC gaps recorded in the byte-bound V7 scientific NO-GO receipt

prohibited_actions: fine-tune or update any learned model parameter on MIMIC or NHANES
distill from any model, age label, disease label, endpoint, or external metric
fit any external correction in the raw zero-shot or sealed-UKB-corrected primary path
select checkpoints, mappings, landmarks, feature cleaning, horizons, endpoints, or calibration after external performance is viewed
use any NHANES questionnaire label file in the model-input process
combine DEMO_J/J_* with P_* in one NHANES analysis
invent cross-release pooled NHANES survey weights
combine MIMIC incident and recurrent endpoints in one table, curve, metric, or claim
use ICD9 for any MIMIC endpoint without a separately audited future authorization
write any formal cache, prediction, metric, HR, KM, CIF, or figure before a frozen contract and exact authorization exist
describe this locked external-cohort reanalysis as untouched, prospective, or independent confirmatory validation
describe relative age+sex statistical increments as clinical utility, deployment readiness, or deployable performance
use external-data-driven trimming, winsorization, quantile clipping, or outlier thresholds for NHANES

primary.crop: latest 32 after exact stable sort and dedup

bare_omr_sensitivity.crop: latest 32 after exact stable sort and dedup

compact_cache_contract.strict_pre_index: active event_time < landmark and relative_days is integer <= -1
compact_cache_contract.text_key_bytes: ASCII semantic role + byte 0x1F + normalized UTF-8 description
compact_cache_contract.nhanes_sequence: 32 padding slots for phenotype_only_label_blind primary input

vocabulary_and_embedding_extension.icd10: NFKC, trim Unicode whitespace, uppercase, remove decimal, exact bare UKB code match first
vocabulary_and_embedding_extension.description_normalization: NFKC then collapse every Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space and trim
vocabulary_and_embedding_extension.unseen_token_order: unique canonical UTF-8 byte strings sorted lexicographically
vocabulary_and_embedding_extension.original_row_bytes_policy: copy original little-endian float16 row bytes as the exact prefix; append extension row bytes; never re-encode original rows
vocabulary_and_embedding_extension.cpu_probe_requirement: encode the same fixed texts twice in one process and require identical SHA-256 after one float32-to-float16 cast
required_coverage_dimensions: source rows by modality and code system
invalid or dropped tokens with closed reason

shared_prediction.ensemble: arithmetic mean of the exact same participant-organ rows from folds 0..4

mimic_iv_3_1.role: hospitalized-EHR transport and hospital-recorded post-discharge risk
mimic_iv_3_1.landmark: discharge time of the second chronologically sorted admission after time-valid, adult-at-discharge, and survived-discharge filtering
mimic_iv_3_1.admission_selection_order: filter finite ordered times, compute integer age and require age>=18, require deathtime absent or after discharge, then stable sort and take ordinal 2
mimic_iv_3_1.admission_sort: admittime ascending, dischtime ascending, numeric hadm_id ascending
mimic_iv_3_1.valid_admission: finite admittime/dischtime, dischtime > admittime, age at discharge >=18, and admissions.deathtime absent or strictly after discharge
mimic_iv_3_1.chronological_age: integer anchor_age + (index discharge calendar year - integer anchor_year); reject anchor_age=91
mimic_iv_3_1.preseal_diagnosis_materialization: PyArrow record-batch stream; predicate hadm_id against completed-admission allowlist with dischtime strictly before landmark; write preindex-only Parquet before any pandas conversion or canonicalization; raw rows converted to pandas and materialized post-index rows must both equal zero
mimic_iv_3_1.phenotype_cutoff: labs require charttime and storetime at or before discharge; date-only OMR must precede the discharge calendar date; both use the frozen 365-day window
mimic_iv_3_1.feature_coverage_output: 01_mimic/01_mapping/feature_coverage.csv with all 78 slots, observed n/fraction, source hash/selector/unit/formula

participant_density.heldout_risk_sensitivity: age+sex+density versus age+sex+density+corrected_gap; density scaling fit on four training folds only
participant_density.interpretation: relative statistical increment only; no clinical utility or deployability claim

cox_ph_diagnostics.coverage: full association age/sex/gap and every held-out target/death base/augmented/density covariate
cox_ph_diagnostics.grain: role x variant x organ x horizon x fold x model x cause x covariate x transform
cox_ph_diagnostics.duration_rule: diagnostic duration = observed_time_days + 1 day for every row, preserving order and ties while supporting day-0 death; log transform is therefore log1p(original days)
cox_ph_diagnostics.global_test: joint scaled-Schoenfeld score vector with complete covariance; never Fisher or minimum-p aggregation

mimic_iv_3_1.diagnosis_time_proxy: associated completed admission dischtime is the availability/event timestamp; preseal model events require dischtime < landmark, baseline endpoint history uses dischtime <= landmark, and post-index outcomes require dischtime > landmark; diagnosis seq_num and hadm_id break ties
mimic_iv_3_1.subject_observation_end: maximum valid admissions.dischtime, labevents.charttime, omr.chartdate, and prescriptions stop/start time, bounded by the frozen death ascertainment cap

phenotype_data_availability.labevents: require nonmissing charttime and storetime, both <= discharge landmark; latest tie order charttime, storetime, labevent_id
phenotype_data_availability.omr: date-only OMR requires chartdate strictly before the discharge calendar date and within the prior 365 calendar days; same-calendar-date OMR is excluded

mimic_iv_3_1.administrative_censor: minimum of prespecified 6/12-month horizon and subject-specific observation end
mimic_iv_3_1.death_ascertainment_cap: minimum of index_time plus the integer calendar-day offset from index date to patients.dod, and last valid hospital discharge plus 365 days; cap is also an administrative censor boundary
mimic_iv_3_1.death_time: date-only patients.dod: dates before index calendar date are inconsistent/excluded; the same calendar date is a conservative day-0 competing death after survived-discharge eligibility; later dates use integer calendar-day offset
postseal_only_fields: min(index_time + integer calendar-day DOD offset, last valid discharge plus 365 days) follow-up cap

incident_primary.target_free_definition: no mapped target-organ ICD10 from any completed admission with dischtime <= index discharge
incident_primary.event: first mapped target-organ ICD10 availability at a completed admission dischtime strictly after index discharge

recurrent_sensitivity.population: mapped target-organ ICD10 available from a completed admission with dischtime <= index discharge and no completed pre-index/index ICD9
recurrent_sensitivity.event: next mapped target-organ ICD10 availability at a completed admission dischtime strictly after index discharge

competing_death.curve_output: 01_mimic/06_incident_risk/competing_risk_curves.csv with AJ target/death CIF and separately labelled cause-specific KM only

mimic_iv_3_1.external_hash_fold: first 8 SHA256 bytes of 'revision0710-external-v3|{subject_id}', big-endian, modulo 5

ipcw.outcome_definition: case=target before death/censor/horizon; control=event-free at horizon or competing death before horizon; loss/admin censor before horizon is unobserved
ipcw.censor_definition: censor event=subject observation end or death ascertainment cap before target/death/horizon; target and death are non-censor terminal events for G
ipcw.absolute_risk: reconstruct post-jump Breslow baseline hazard increments from complete target and competing-death PHReg risk sets, including first and final event-time jumps, then integrate them into target CIF; use target Cox linear predictor for cause-specific Harrell C and target CIF probability for IPCW AUC, Brier, and linear calibration
ipcw.brier_normalization: sum IPCW squared error divided by full held-out test n
ipcw.diagnostics: unfloored G minimum, G floor, training p99 cap, capped count, effective sample size, observed and censored counts

full_cohort_hr.analysis_population: full non-held-out organ-specific incident-eligible cohort after excluding baseline target ICD10 and any completed pre-index ICD9; not the full 95,683-subject MIMIC input cohort
full_cohort_hr.exposure: corrected_age_gap_mean5 standardized by the incident-eligible organ-specific analysis-population SD
full_cohort_hr.covariates: integer chronological age + sex_male + standardized corrected age gap
full_cohort_hr.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across seven organs within each input variant and horizon
full_cohort_hr.proportional_hazards_test: scaled Schoenfeld residual test for exposure

mimic_iv_3_1.bootstrap: one global PCG64 SeedSequence subject-cluster multiplicity plan with B=200 shared across all organs, horizons, variants, and fixed hash folds; resample held-out subjects while keeping training-fold target Cox, death Cox, and censoring KM fixed
claim_limits: hospital-recorded endpoints, not complete population incidence
only 6- and 12-month horizons are authorized under the available death ascertainment
non-held-out incident-eligible organ-specific HR is association, held-out delta C/IPCW is prediction, neither is causal

nhanes.role: cross-sectional phenotype-domain transfer and disease association, not longitudinal incident prediction
nhanes.p_release: official P_* 2017-March 2020 pre-pandemic release, including the 2017-2018 sample
nhanes.primary_age_population: RIDSTATR == 2 and RIDAGEYR integer 40 through 73 inclusive
nhanes.primary_age_integer_guard: fractional RIDAGEYR in the examined 40-73 candidate range is a hard error
nhanes.age_80_top_coded: exclude from MAE, RMSE, R2, calibration intercept/slope, and every exact-error calculation; inclusion is an exact error
nhanes.feature_map: 78 slots for each release; unavailable slots remain raw_zero=0/missing_mask=true

release_slot_qc.required_fields: finite count, prefrozen physical-unit range count, min, q01, q25, median, q75, q99, max
release_slot_qc.decision_rule: any observed nonfinite or value outside a prefrozen unit range aborts before inference

nhanes.questionnaire_labels: exploratory Panel E; six estimable organs per release; immune fixed not_estimable; outcome-only physical process

local_crossfit_calibration.folds: for held-out hash fold k, fit on the other four folds within the same release and organ
local_crossfit_calibration.application: apply the three training-fold coefficients once to held-out predicted_age_raw_mean5 and sex_male
local_crossfit_calibration.role: sensitivity only; never zero-shot and never enters primary predictions or corrected gaps

questionnaire_association.exposure: corrected_age_gap_mean5 standardized within release and organ
questionnaire_association.covariates: intercept + standardized corrected gap + chronological age centered per 10 years + sex_male
questionnaire_association.design: full release-specific examined MEC design retained; integer age 40-73 enters as a survey domain; MEC weight, SDMVSTRA strata, SDMVPSU PSU
questionnaire_association.inference: survey-domain pseudolikelihood Taylor linearization with PSU within strata, centered lonely PSU, and t/Wald reference using design df = PSU minus strata
questionnaire_association.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across six estimable organs within each release

nhanes.claim_limit: locked release-specific age-transfer reanalysis and exploratory cross-sectional association only; not untouched confirmation, incident prediction, clinical utility, deployability, longitudinal robustness, causal effect, or network conservation

statistical_algorithms.aalen_johansen: at each unique event time update all-cause survival S(t)=S(t-)*(1-d_all/n); add CIF_k(t)=CIF_k(t-)+S(t-)*d_k/n; death is cause 2 and wins exact ties
statistical_algorithms.harrell_c: comparable pairs require earlier observed target event; ties in risk contribute 0.5
statistical_algorithms.phreg_baseline_hazard: use fitted Efron PHReg coefficients but reconstruct Breslow dH0(t)=d(t)/sum_{i:Ti>=t}exp(xi beta) directly from the complete risk set; cumulative risk at a horizon is the sum of all jumps at t<=horizon, including first and final event-time jumps
statistical_algorithms.ipcw_auc_brier: target CIF from explicit post-jump Breslow target/death cause-specific hazard jumps; IPCW AUC ranks target CIF probability rather than target cause-specific linear predictor; case=target before terminal boundary; control=event-free at horizon or competing death before horizon; subject observation/admin censor before horizon is unobserved; fit censoring KM on four training folds, evaluate left-limit G on held-out fold, clamp G at 0.05, cap at training-weight p99; Brier divides by full test n
statistical_algorithms.bootstrap: one global PCG64 SeedSequence participant-cluster multiplicity plan retained across organs, horizons, variants, and folds; predictive intervals are conditional on fixed training-fold target/death Cox and censor KM
statistical_algorithms.uncertainty: predictive rows use linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles over B=200 conditional held-out subject-cluster replicates; zero-shot age metrics, full time-grid curves, and recurrent CIFs are explicitly point-only; Cox HRs use robust Wald intervals

output_schema.formal_receipt: one create-once manifest with path, bytes, SHA256, rows, columns, and formula/tolerance schema SHA256 for each of all 20 tables
